title: 肺癌新药试验失败：另一项却成关键转折，分析师为何更看重它
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Sam Fizzelli, Senior Pharmaceutical Analyst from Bloomberg Intelligence, joins us now.
segments.zh: 彭博智库高级制药分析师Sam Fizzelli现在加入我们。

segments.en: Sam, can you just weigh the news here? One trial, not successful. Two other ones that did seem to have positive results.
segments.zh: Sam，你能评估一下这个消息吗？一项试验未成功，另外两项似乎有积极结果。

segments.en: Yeah, Danny. So, this is a, you know, taking an isolation here today.
segments.zh: 是的，Danny。今天我们要单独看这个情况。

segments.en: We have one of the trials that failed. It's a very experimental therapy called Vorostomig.
segments.zh: 有一项试验失败了，那是一种非常实验性的疗法，叫做Vorostomig。

segments.en: And they were really testing their, I would say, their luck with this particular angle, trying to go for the hardest to treat lung cancer patients, didn't work out.
segments.zh: 他们确实是在这个方向上碰运气，试图治疗最难治的肺癌患者，但没有成功。

segments.en: It was going up against the standard of care, the gold standard of care, which is Merck's Ketruda plus chemotherapy. So, that didn't work out. However, there's two other trials,
segments.zh: 它对比的是标准疗法，即默克的Keytruda加化疗。那项没成功。不过还有另外两项试验，

segments.en: the one in called Inher too, Destiny Lung. That one is less relevant because it's a smaller indication. But the one that's really interesting is this trial called Saffron,
segments.zh: 一项叫Inhertoo Destiny Lung，那项不太相关，因为适应症较小。但真正有趣的是叫SAFFRON的试验，

segments.en: which is in the area where they already have a major blockbuster Tegreso, which is a mutated lung cancer, EGFR mutated lung cancer. Here, they've got a new drug to add to it, or all,
segments.zh: 该试验针对的是他们已有重磅药Tegreso的领域，即EGFR突变肺癌。这里他们有一种新药可以加入，

segments.en: that gives them an option to treat patients once they progress. And that is quite relevant here because I think they can extend the timeline by which they can, they keep continuing to treat
segments.zh: 这让他们在患者进展后有了治疗选择。这相当重要，因为我认为他们可以延长继续治疗的时间线，

segments.en: the Tegreso, and of course, this additional drug. That's the more relevant news for me today, to be honest. I wonder, Sam, if there's any degree, which we should look at the context of this,
segments.zh: 继续使用Tegreso，当然还有这种附加药物。对我来说，这才是今天更相关的消息。Sam，我想知道，我们是否应该从背景来看待这个？

segments.en: of some of the M&A noise around AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers, if there is greater concerns on the pipeline of AstraZeneca, because these conversations were reported to have taken place,
segments.zh: 关于阿斯利康和百时美施贵宝的并购传闻，如果市场对阿斯利康的研发管线有更多担忧，因为这些对话据报已经发生
